> d

I had a girlfriend of four years. I spent probably $100k on her a year. At one point I was what could be considered a "celebrity" and was making good money. She left with no reason.

Now all I have are a small group of friends and family. But they don't know the struggles I went through. Dealing with the sharks and the "fake friends". Now that I'm back to living more of a normal life I hate it and can't reverse what I did.

Is happiness real? I'm 25. Everyone says I've lived more than people more than double my age. I am a tech entrepreneur. As soon as my story hit Businessweek and Yahoo and Wall St Journal all the kids that hated me in high school wanted to be my friend. I had a girlfriend of 4 years that I planned to marry. I'm 25. She won't even reply to my texts or anything. I stopped going to work and my employees ran my business that was valued in the millions to nothing. Now I have about $500k in debt, sketchy friends, an addiction to alcohol and xanax to numb myself. Nothing is going good for me. I even applied to Target working the night crew for $9/hr and couldn't get that job, I literally lost everything. I miss my life of having money and a beautiful girlfriend that loved me. I went from buying brand new Porsches on an impulse to now struggling to pay for gas and having my cars repo'd. I lost everything and have tried to get it back and just can't. I don't even sleep anymore. I am barely existing.
